issues: Resolved before render: the actor's facing flip used transformOrigin in px on an SVG <g>. GSAP needs svgOrigin in user units there, and the wrong one threw the whole figure off the page from 26.2s to the end. It is invisible in a still and only showed up on the first full render — the reason this pipeline's compose stage insists on sampling the finished file.

Resolved before render: the sit clip is exactly 6.00s and the segment was 6.60s, so it wrapped and began sitting down again instead of ending on its feet. Fixed with loop:false, which holds the clip's last frame.

Resolved before render: the character had no visible face — the style's white-dot eyes are invisible on an unfilled head on white paper — so the turn at 26.2s did not read at all on a symmetrical stick figure. Two ink eyes and a nose, both on one side, fixed both problems at once.
Accepted: the catalog has no 'stands still, confused' clip, so the search beat is carried by shuffle plus staging. Verified legible on the contact sheet; the library was not extended.
